display.purpose: Section titles only (über mich., arbeit., kontakt.). The loudest type on the page.

headline.purpose: The hero statement — the first sentence a visitor reads.

body.purpose: About paragraphs and project descriptions. Measure 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Geist Mono tracked-uppercase metadata: project labels, skill-group titles, form labels, filter chips, stack line, footer credit.

motion.name: transition-color
motion.purpose: Default color/background transition on links, nav, tabs, and buttons.

motion.name: bob
motion.purpose: Idle bob on the scroll indicators. Must be disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Vertical rail link; Dim at rest, Ink + heavier weight when active or hovered.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #888888; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='true'] { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00aaff; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: Text-only call to action with a 1px underline; commits to Signal Blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; padding: 0.6875rem 0.5rem; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { color: #00aaff; } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00aaff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Submit Button
components.description: The page's primary action; Surface Raised at rest, fills with Signal Blue Deep on hover so the white label stays legible (~4.9:1). The one place a solid blue fill is allowed.
components.css: .ds-btn-submit { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 36px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-submit:hover { background: #0077b6; } .ds-btn-submit:active { background: #005f95; } .ds-btn-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00aaff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Borderless input living inside a Surface card; the card is the input affordance. Focus lifts a Signal Blue ring on the card.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: #0d0d0d; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-field:focus-within { outline: 1px solid #00aaff; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888888; } .ds-field-input { background: none; border: none; outline: none; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; width: 100%; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #888888; }

components.name: Bento Image Tile
components.description: The frame for project imagery; the single large-radius element in the system. Holds a cover-fit photo. Shown here empty with an image glyph.
components.css: .ds-bento-tile { background: #0d0d0d; border-radius: 20px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bento-tile svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; color: #444444; }

components.name: Project Highlight List
components.description: Highlight bullets led by a Signal Blue em-dash instead of a disc; the accent does the marking.
components.html:
• Design-DNA aus einem Foto extrahiert
  • Direkte Canvas-Bearbeitung mit Undo/Redo
  • Druckfertiger PDF-Export
components.css: .ds-highlight { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-highlight li { position: relative; padding-left: 14px; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #888888; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-highlight li::before { content: '—'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: #00aaff; }

narrative.overview: The page is a pure black field, and light is used the way a darkroom uses it: sparingly, deliberately, to bring one thing into focus at a time. Nothing on screen arrived by accident. Type is set in one precise grotesque (Geist), display and body separated by weight, with Geist Mono giving the metadata its spec-sheet voice; surfaces are nearly black so the work itself is the brightest thing in the room, and a single cool blue marks the few places that genuinely matter. The atmosphere is dark and focused, precise and engineered. It serves a recruiter and a prospective client at once, answering both by showing the work cleanly rather than talking about it. It rejects the generic AI / template SaaS look, corporate-agency boilerplate, the resume data-dump, and loud maximalism.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-black canvas; surfaces only one or two shades up from black.
One cool accent (Signal Blue), used like punctuation, never as wallpaper.
One grotesque family (Geist) carries the page; display and body split by weight, with Geist Mono for metadata labels.
Flat by default — depth comes from tonal layering, never from shadows.
The work (project imagery) is the loudest thing on any screen.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears on no more than ~10% of any screen. It marks what matters and nothing else; the moment a second hue or a large blue fill shows up, the signal becomes noise.

rules.name: The Muted-Floor Rule
rules.body: #444444 on #000000 is ~2.5:1 — below the WCAG AA floor. Muted is permitted only for short, large, or peripheral labels, never for sentences a visitor needs to read. Real content sits at Dim #888888 (~5.9:1) or brighter.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for small tracked-uppercase labels and the stack line; it never sets a sentence, a heading, or interactive nav. Nav, audience tabs, and the hero CTA are Geist sans. One grotesque (Geist) carries display and body, separated by weight, never by a second face.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift with a drop shadow or glow. If something needs to feel closer, raise its tone one step (#0d0d0d to #111); never reach for box-shadow.

dos: Do keep Signal Blue (#00aaff) to ~10% of any screen — labels, link hover, the em-dash bullets. Its scarcity is the point.
Do use the deeper blue (#0077b6) for fills that carry white text, like the submit button hover, so the label stays legible.
Do set real body text at Dim (#888888) or brighter on Void; reserve Muted (#444444) for short peripheral labels only.
Do convey depth by stepping tone up (#000 to #0d0d0d to #111), never with shadows.
Do carry the page on Geist alone, separating display from body by weight; reserve Geist Mono for small tracked-uppercase metadata, never for sentences or nav.
Do give every interactive element a visible :focus-visible state and a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative for the bob/scroll animations.
Do show real project imagery in every bento grid. One decisive screenshot beats an empty tile.
donts: Don't ship the generic AI / template SaaS look: no gradient blobs, no identical icon-card grids, no tracked-uppercase eyebrow above every section, no 01 / 02 / 03 numbered section scaffolding.
Don't drift into corporate / agency boilerplate or buzzword voice. This is one person under a studio name; write like it.
Don't turn sections into a CV / resume data-dump. Projects are stories (problem to build to outcome), not walls of bullets.
Don't go loud or flashy — no neon, no heavy or gratuitous animation. Restraint is the register.
Don't add box-shadow to any surface (breaks The No-Shadow Rule).
Don't use Muted (#444) for sentences — it fails WCAG AA on black (~2.5:1).
Don't round form cards, inputs, or buttons past 4px; the only large radius (20px) belongs to image tiles.
Don't leave colored placeholder divs where project screenshots belong — zero imagery reads as unfinished on a brand surface.
Don't use em dashes or -- in prose copy; the em-dash is a visual bullet here, not a sentence connector.
